policy: the enforcing policy the suite applies lives in src/csp.ts; it is deliberately strict — 'self' and nothing else — so that every inline fragment the storefront emits shows up
state: the storefront does not run clean under it today: every entry below is a fragment that an enforcing policy blocks, recorded so a new one stands out. See registry entry security/csp/inline-without-nonce.

accepted.emittedBy: MageObsidian_ModernFrontend's import map, written into the head so bare vue specifiers resolve without a bundler
accepted.reason: an import map cannot be moved to an external file: the specification only honours an inline one, so it needs a nonce rather than a relocation

accepted.emittedBy: the speculation rules the theme emits to prefetch same-origin documents
accepted.reason: speculation rules are inline JSON by design; the fragment is data the browser reads, not code it runs, but the policy still counts it under script-src

accepted.emittedBy: the prepaint runtime seed: the section storage keys and counters the header reads before any module loads
accepted.reason: it has to run before the first paint, which is why it is inline; a nonce is what it needs

accepted.emittedBy: the i18n seed: the locale and the dictionary URL
accepted.reason: a per-store value that cannot live in a cacheable static file

accepted.emittedBy: the section store seed: lifetime and which sections expire
accepted.reason: a per-store value that cannot live in a cacheable static file

accepted.emittedBy: SectionPrefetchRuntime, which starts the private-data request before the island graph has loaded
accepted.reason: its whole purpose is to fire earlier than any module could, so it is inline on purpose

accepted.emittedBy: the UX config seed: optimistic updates and whether counters show quantities
accepted.reason: a per-store value that cannot live in a cacheable static file

accepted.emittedBy: the icon config seed: the base URL of the versioned icon directory
accepted.reason: carries the static-content version, which changes on every deploy

accepted.emittedBy: the island runtime's cloak rule, which hides an island until it mounts
accepted.reason: it must apply before any stylesheet has arrived, which is exactly what it is for

accepted.emittedBy: the theme's view-transition rules for the header
accepted.reason: part of the critical CSS the theme inlines on purpose

accepted.emittedBy: MageObsidian\Storefront\ViewModel\NavOverflow::getStyle, the generated stylesheet that decides how many nav items fit
accepted.reason: it is computed from this store's own category labels, so it cannot be a static file

accepted.emittedBy: Magento's own image block, which sizes each container with a generated rule
accepted.reason: core behaviour the migrated template inherited, not something the theme introduced

accepted.emittedBy: elements the server renders hidden until the client takes over
accepted.reason: a per-element decision the server makes; it needs a class instead of an attribute to satisfy the policy

accepted.emittedBy: the fluid type scale, applied per element from the design tokens
accepted.reason: a per-element decision; it needs a class instead of an attribute to satisfy the policy

accepted.emittedBy: the colour swatches, whose value is the attribute option's own hex colour
accepted.reason: the value is data, and there is no fixed set of classes that could carry it

accepted.emittedBy: the view transitions, which need a unique name per card, cart line and summary
accepted.reason: the name has to be unique per element, so it cannot come from a stylesheet

accepted.emittedBy: progress and fill bars whose width is a computed percentage
accepted.reason: the value is data, and there is no fixed set of classes that could carry it
